summary: Builds the 'Game Filter' UI screen: captures UI dimensions, tears down the previous widget linked lists (calling each widget's virtual destructor and freeing nodes, then zeroing the four list heads this+0xF0..0xFC), cleans the resource list at this+0x180, builds the track filter via ConditionalDispatch_81f0/SceneFileFilterBuilder, then iterates the track list producing one UI widget per track (car-icon handle + track name) and finalizes the viewport layout.

local_names.v2: current node pointer while walking the widget cleanup list
local_names.v27: 256-byte scratch buffer holding the constructed track name / icon path
local_names.v24: 63-byte track name buffer filled by TrackNameReader
local_names.v9: newly allocated and initialized UI widget object
local_names.v23: track/scene count read from the resource list

operations.description: UIDimensionCapture() captures the current UI dimensions before layout is rebuilt.

Walk the widget linked list from head this+0xF0 following the +4 next-pointer: for each node whose +12 flag is set and whose vtable (*v3) is non-null, call the virtual destructor (vtable[0])(node, 1), then FreeWrapper_7bcf(node).
Zero the four UI widget list heads this+0xF0, this+0xF4, this+0xF8, this+0xFC after the cleanup walk.
ResourceListCleanup_62c0(this + 0x180) tears down the resource list object that holds the track filter state.
ConditionalDispatch_81f0(aGameFilter) resolves the 'Game Filter' string, then SceneFileFilterBuilder(result) rebuilds the scene/track filter from it.
ReadFieldAtOffset0x14(this + 0x180) reads the track/scene count used to bound the per-track loop.
Per-track loop over the count: LinkedListRandomAccess(index) fetches each track node; the body runs only for non-null nodes.
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(72) allocates a new widget and UIObjectInit(v8) initializes it into v9.

Copy the path from node+4 into the 256-byte scratch buffer v27 (seeded first byte from byte_5EA438), then strip everything after the last backslash (0x5C), leaving the bare filename; finally strcat the track name from node+260.
Append the icon name suffix to the buffer end: dword_5C7150, dword_5C7154, then the low word word_5C7158.
sub_497AD0(v27, 0) looks up the car-icon resource by the built name, falling back to sub_497AD0(aDfcariconBmp, 0); on success StructFieldCopy_fc80(handle) copies the handle into the widget.

TrackSceneLoader(node+260) loads the track scene data, TrackNameReader(v24, 63) reads the track name into a 63-byte buffer, and StringCopyWithBufferRealloc is applied to both the name buffer and node+260.
Store the track node handle into widget+0x3C (v9[15] = node) and DoublyLinkedListAppend_f5d0(widget, 1) links the widget into the UI list.
Finalize: SceneListSearchByPath(this) then UIViewportLayoutCalculator(this) lay out the assembled widget viewport.
